metadata.note: HAND-AUTHORED edge dataset for the load-time validity check on issue #476 - NOT a slice of the shipped KB, which offers no row at these edges (measured 2026-09-24 by driving DrugReferenceService.getLoadStatus() over the shipped file with the bridge's ingredient keyed by its display stem: the reported rows did not change). TWO POSITIVES. Trailexine publishes rxnorm_name `wrongazine`, and the bridge files `Trailexine (anhydrous) / partnerine` on Partnerine and not on it - the ingredient carries a trailing qualifier. Qualifiedazole (oral) publishes rxnorm_name `elsewherine`, and the bridge files `Qualifiedazole / partnerine` on Partnerine and not on it - the ROW carries the qualifier, so the rule must compare the row's display stem and not its whole name. ONE CONTROL: Ownqualine publishes rxnorm_name `otherone`, and the one concept naming it, `Ownqualine (anhydrous) / partnerine`, is filed on Ownqualine itself as well as on Partnerine, so the bridge does not contradict it. The control must NOT be reported.
